title: az devops invoke --area git --resource pullRequestThreads --route-parameters project=${project} repositoryId=${repository} pullRequestId=${id} --api-version 7.1 --output json
description: The pull request's comment threads, which `modules/bash/forge/ado.sh` (forge/ado:open-prs) reads and `modules/jq/forge.jq`'s ado_unresolved counts: those a person opened, active or pending, not deleted; every call kit makes through forge/ado:az also carries --org ${organization} --detect false --only-show-errors. az devops invoke prints the REST API's answer as it comes, a collection of GitPullRequestCommentThread with its Comment list, https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azure/devops/git/pull-request-threads/list?view=azure-devops-rest-7.1.

status.description: CommentThreadStatus, left out of a thread Azure DevOps writes itself, such as a vote.

commentType.description: CommentType: text is a person's comment, system one Azure DevOps writes.
